description: This line plot illustrates the Pass@1 rate (%) as a function of the number of reasoning steps, comparing the performance of two large language models: GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet. The x-axis, labeled "Num. of Reasoning Steps," uses a linear scale ranging from 5 to 40, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Pass@1 Rate (%)", uses a linear scale from 0 to 100, with tick marks at intervals of 20. The GPT-4o performance is represented by a solid blue line with circular markers, starting at 6.5% at 5 steps and increasing to 83.9% at 40 steps. The Claude-3.5-Sonnet performance is represented by a dashed light blue line with 'x' markers, starting at 19.4% at 5 steps and increasing to 89.2% at 40 steps. Both lines show a generally increasing trend with more reasoning steps, with Claude-3.5-Sonnet consistently outperforming GPT-4o across all measured step counts.
